items.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase won't allow outside artificial intelligence agents to access customer accounts and operate on their behalf, CEO Jamie Dimon said Tuesday, citing risks to the company and its customers as tech firms including Meta release autonomous assistants.

items.title: Visa gets Beijing's green light for bank card business after 40 years of working with China
items.summary: BEIJING — U.S. credit card giant Visa announced Tuesday it had received approval from the People's Bank of China for setting up a bank card clearing business in the country.

items.title: 'Boring is not bad': CEO of Southeast Asia's largest bank pitches Singapore as a haven amid global turmoil
items.summary: SINGAPORE — Southeast Asia's biggest bank by assets is making a pitch to investors that Singapore and its businesses can help them navigate many of the uncertainties around the globe.

items.title: Higher rates could be needed to avoid 'inflationary mindset' taking hold, says Fed's Hammack
items.summary: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack indicated Monday that tighter monetary policy might be needed to bring down inflation and the central bank should make fast, incremental adjustments.

items.title: The bull market turned 4 years old on Monday. Investors say reaching a fifth birthday could be challenging
items.summary: Happy birthday to the bull market, which just turned four.

items.title: Inflation likely peaked for 2026 but will remain sticky, according to prediction markets
items.summary: Traders on prediction market platform Kalshi think inflation likely reached a peak for the year, though they don't see a sharp move lower anytime soon.

items.title: The latest inflation data is expected to show price increases are accelerating
items.summary: Wednesday's closely watched reading on consumer prices could show intensifying inflationary pressures as energy costs keep climbing.

items.title: In charts: How one of the world's biggest economies got trapped by debt
items.summary: France's parliament begins debate on the 2027 budget Tuesday as high deficits, rising debt and student protests sharpen the political cost of fiscal consolidation.

items.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
items.summary: Government bond yields in several advanced economies have climbed to multidecade highs, driven by higher energy costs due to the Middle East conflict and expectations for tighter monetary conditions as central banks look to curb resurgent inflation.

items.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
items.summary: BANGKOK — The International Monetary Fund has raised its forecast for global growth this year as the AI-driven investment boom helps offset some of the impact from surging energy costs, while warning that economic resilience could be nearing its breaking point.
